items.title: Kraken brings DeFi yield to tokenized stocks and ETFs
items.summary: Kraken’s new xStocks vaults let investors earn yield on tokenized versions of Nvidia and major US stock market ETFs by lending the assets in DeFi markets.

items.title: Bitmine projects $334M in annual staking revenue from $15.8B crypto treasury
items.summary: Bitmine now has more than 5 million ETH staked, turning most of its Ether holdings into a recurring income stream as it continues to accumulate.

items.title: Bitmine adds 27,180 ETH as adviser Tom DeMark sees sharp move in coming weeks
items.summary: Bitmine added 27,180 ETH, taking its holdings to 5.96 million as advisor Tom DeMark forecasts a sharp upward move.

items.title: Dogecoin ETFs struggled for buyers while rival XRP and Solana funds pulled in $3 billion
items.summary: Bitwise's BWOW dogecoin ETF will close after 10 months, adding to weak demand across DOGE funds and raising a harder question for altcoin ETFs: What problem are they actually solving?
